column1: H1-ORR1H1-CRD1The Observable Representation shall preserve whether a collision-relevant obstacle is present in the operational situation.ObstaclePresent_R(x) != ObstaclePresent_R(y) for situations separated by H1-CRD1.H-1;FR-7;FR-7.2;FR-7.2.1Without this distinction the representation cannot support evaluation of whether an obstacle-induced braking condition exists.

H1-ORR2H1-CRD2The Observable Representation shall preserve the source-required distinction between vulnerable road users and other objects when an obstacle is represented.VRU_R(x) != VRU_R(y) for situations separated by H1-CRD2.FR-7.2.2The visible functional specification explicitly requires this category distinction within obstacle information supporting the braking concern.

H1-ORR3H1-CRD3The Observable Representation shall preserve whether the spatial relation between the ego vehicle and an obstacle falls in a condition requiring braking or one not requiring braking.BrakingRelevantDistanceClass_R(x) != BrakingRelevantDistanceClass_R(y) for situations separated by H1-CRD3.H-1;FR-7.1;FR-7.2.4Distance is explicitly required for the braking concern, but the dangerous-zone boundary is tbd; therefore the ORR preserves the concern-relative distance class without inventing a numerical threshold.
